result: No unresolved material finding in the declared supported source route

resolved_findings.resolution: Export and every current read use _selected_binary, bind the actual resolved executable path and hash, and reject a retargeted selected executable even when the old target remains unchanged.

Contact diagnostics reject non-absolute executable selections at export and current reads. The view also requires the saved absolute lexical path without PATH/cwd lookup. Empty selection retains the absolute bundled path; legacy ordinary/force-accounting-only selection behavior is not changed.
_capture reads at most the declared size limit plus one byte, compares opened identity before reading, hashes the captured bytes, and fences pre/opened/post/final regular-file identities.

_model walks the non-result physical dependency graph, including nested resolved App::Links, and refuses external-document or unavailable inputs before invoking the shared document-local digest. The check is used at export and current validation.
The final retained frame must explicitly be complete at the exact requested end time. Near-end incomplete frames no longer pass an isclose-only final check.

Per-analysis latest-attempt tokens are withdrawn by every rewrite/new attempt. finish_run ignores superseded completions without invalidating a newer child's result; document deletion removes the attempt registry.

Close/cancel withdraws native contexts, includes Starting and Running children, uses bounded terminate/kill waits and keeps the task open if its child survives. Cancelled completions cannot import native or mechanical output. A Stop click cannot immediately launch another child through the shared Run slot.

The inspector records finite lexical and encountered-target symlink topology using fenced lstat/readlink identities, watches containing directories, checks topology and selected resolved path on events, and rechecks after watch registration. Leaf and ancestor-directory retargeting withdraw the table without automatic refresh. A 256-path cap rejects unsupported topology rather than silently omitting watches.

GUI and synchronous runners independently collect force-accounting completion/import errors and contact-state completion errors. Ambient observer activation is scrubbed. A force-accounting finish error does not skip contact-state completion.
The contract's build command now explicitly supplies --contact-source package/calculix/force-accounting/contactstate.c.
